claims.statement: Although metadata includes FPT, GHEC and GHES, this signup procedure explicitly excludes enterprise managed users and GHES users; company-provisioned users may skip it, and GHES directs account creation questions to the site administrator. Metadata is not self-service eligibility.

Cloud onboarding describes a personal account with a verified email address. The included personal-account fragment identifies a user account by username and profile; these identity properties do not prove authorization, verification or an adopted policy.

Free cloud accounts support Google or Apple social login. The source says iOS Apple Hide My Email still creates a new GitHub account; that is not an assurance of privacy, mailbox ownership or linkage to an existing account.

Eligible personal signup follows the cloud signup prompts or Continue with Google. An email already verified for an enterprise managed user cannot be used to sign up for a personal account; this is not a blanket claim that every unverified managed identity is eligible.

Signup requests email verification; without verification some basic tasks including repository creation are unavailable. Cloud troubleshooting is linked conditionally, but following a link or requesting verification is not evidence of successful verification.

Configuring two-factor authentication is a strong source recommendation, not proof of enrollment or an automatically accepted mandatory local control. Account-type and billing-plan links are optional exploration, not authority for subscriptions or costs.
